notes.text: /sell <item> sells that item to the last shop you opened: everything you carry plus your storage, in as many trips as your weight allows.
/sell red blood >100 keeps 100 in the storage.
Add gstorage to sell from the guild storage too; off unless you type it.
A Sell all button in the NPC sell window puts every listed item in the selling list. Nothing is sold until you press Sell.
Favorites follow the favorite tab's lock: locked, they stay out; unlocked, Sell all takes them too.
